sections.title: Burt's characterisation
sections.line: Burt, chapter on Virgo, pdf pp. 211–252. Her account of the earth, the purity and the ruler.

quotes.quote: Virgo is Mutable, or passive-responsive to events and circumstances, especially those involved with the Sixth House of labor,
The earthy nature of Virgo seems to provide Hermes the patience and powers of concentration required for his serious healing and alchemical work.
As ruler of the Earth sign Virgo, Hermes seems less flighty, more grounded, stable and consistent in his behavior than he was as ruler of airy Gemini.
Virgo is pure in the sense that it is open and receptive to life.

quotes.quote: The esoteric ruler of Virgo is the Moon, an intuitive, nurturing planet.
Virginity is a matter of attitude, not a matter of bodily intactness.

sections.title: What Jung says
sections.line: Jung on the virgin in his seminar.

quotes.quote: When man is roaring like a lion there is nothing better to tame him than a virgin.
When the sun came into Pisces, Virgo became the autumnal sign, and astrology has connected that fact with the worship of the Virgin Mary.
